AI coding agents modifying this React + Vite + Tailwind CSS ML portfolio must follow these rules. Present the BCA student’s work authentically and honestly. Avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise. Use modern developer-portfolio or AI-dashboard styling, accents `#38BDF8` and `#22D3EE`, and Space Grotesk headings. H1 → main page headlines.

Use reusable React components. Keep components modular and readable. Include Titanic Survival Prediction: Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Logistic Regression; Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn. Avoid heavy animations or distracting motion. Use icons for navigation, skills, and project cards. Ensure mobile-first design. Avoid unnecessary dependencies. Follow clean React practices. Avoid overly complex code.

Content must remain authentic. Do NOT claim:
professional experience not actually achieved
research credentials not earned

If technically feasible, AI agents may implement a “Try the Model” Titanic survival prediction input form. If implementation becomes complex, skip this feature. Changes are complete when the UI is clean and modern, ML projects are clearly presented, the portfolio feels authentic, mobile layout works well, and performance remains fast.
